description: Confirms that the token-saver MCP server is reachable. Use this when asked to probe, test, or verify the token-saver connection. Pass a nonce of 1 to 64 ASCII letters or digits; the result echoes it with the server's instance_id, server_version, and status. It reads nothing and changes nothing.

nonce.description: Caller-chosen token of 1 to 64 ASCII letters or digits, echoed back verbatim.

name: connection_probe
title: Connection probe
